name: Linkwarden
description: Collaborative bookmark manager and web archive.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://linkwarden:{{envRaw.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-db:5432/linkwarden"
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: {{env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET}}
      NEXTAUTH_URL: {{env.NEXTAUTH_URL}}
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-db
  {{serviceName}}-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: linkwarden
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: linkwarden
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
